title: Deep Down Below
author: Taku483
selftext:
Hey everyone! I’ve joined you in experimenting with AI-assisted game development :-)

This is **Deep down below**, a peaceful underwater exploration game where you pilot a small submarine through reefs, caves, and glowing depths.

It’s still an early tech demo and a just-for-fun project using codex for coding and integrating/creating some assets, but I’m hoping to keep building on it over time. There are definitely some rough edges, so constructive feedback is very welcome!

You can play it for free in your desktop browser:  
[https://capyku.itch.io/deep-down-below](https://capyku.itch.io/deep-down-below)

If you have any questions or suggestions, let me know!

Cheers,  
Taku
